# Icons

70 named glyphs from the icon font in `components/bundle.css`. Never draw an SVG icon the system has.

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Icon name="play" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Icon" name="play"></x-import>
```

`activity`, `arrow-down`, `arrow-up`, `box`, `cable`, `camera`, `check`, `chevron-down`, `chevron-left`, `chevron-right`, `chevron-up`, `chevrons-up-down`, `circle-alert`, `circle-check`, `circle-x`, `clock`, `cloud`, `copy`, `cpu`, `database`, `download`, `ellipsis`, `ellipsis-vertical`, `external-link`, `eye`, `eye-off`, `file-text`, `folder`, `folder-kanban`, `funnel`, `globe`, `hard-drive`, `house`, `info`, `key`, `layers`, `layout-grid`, `link`, `list`, `lock`, `log-out`, `memory-stick`, `menu`, `minus`, `monitor`, `moon`, `network`, `panel-left`, `pause`, `pencil`, `play`, `plus`, `power`, `refresh-cw`, `rotate-ccw`, `rotate-cw`, `search`, `server`, `settings`, `shield`, `snowflake`, `square`, `sun`, `tag`, `terminal`, `trash`, `triangle-alert`, `upload`, `user`, `x`
